components.name: Historical publisher drawing OpenSSL 1.1.1f SHA-512 implementation
components.applicability: Historical upstream drawing recipe only. Excluded from the distributed rebuilt drawing runtime; font manifest never selected this implementation.
components.assessment: Resolved by rebuilding unchanged core source with USE_OPENSSL_HASH removed and no OpenSSL source/header/archive present. This selects the existing Xpdf SHA-384/SHA-512 branch. Old OpenSSL notices are retained solely to document the superseded publisher build/source inputs; they do not assert implementation inclusion in current binaries.

exclusions.name: OpenSSL implementation in x2t
exclusions.basis: Distributed x2t.js declares explicit missing-function abort stubs for OpenSSL imports. Native-host tool libraries are not presumed incorporated into the final WASM. Header-only/inline copied material remains separately auditable.

exclusions.name: FFmpeg / libav codecs / VLC
exclusions.basis: No FFmpeg/libav/VLC implementation sources or link inputs selected by final converter Docker stages or publisher drawing/font manifests.

exclusions.name: curl
exclusions.basis: No libcurl library compiled/copied by the converter Docker final dependency stages; network helper object is a separate application wrapper. No inference from repository-wide curl.pri.

exclusions.name: HEIF / libde265 / x265 implementations
exclusions.basis: Positive binary evidence: all18 imported HEIF API functions are bound by x2t.js to abort missing-function stubs (.stub=true), including allocation/encode/decode/image operations; exact import bindings are in runtimeImportEvidence. Native-host codec build archives are not copied into final WASM link. Publisher drawing/font source manifests omit HEIF. Complete codec source archives remain retained as build dependencies.

exclusions.name: AGG GPC and examples
exclusions.basis: Selected raster/AGG sources and drawing/font manifests do not include gpc.c or examples. GPC noncommercial terms are not attributed to AGG renderer.

exclusions.name: dcraw/libdcr implementation
exclusions.basis: Selected vendored libdcr.c is empty; file name alone is not evidence of included dcraw implementation.

exclusions.name: OpenSSL implementation in current drawing runtime
exclusions.basis: Verified patched recipe removes USE_OPENSSL_HASH and OpenSSL include paths while retaining all40 compile groups. Actual successful source tree contains no OpenSSL implementation directory. Existing Decrypt.cc fallback SHA functions compile instead; distributed outputs match recorded rebuilt hashes. The former publisher binary issue is retained as historicalReleaseFinding.

runtimeImportEvidence.method: Named missing-function abort stubs in shipped JS correlated to actual WASM function import descriptors; retained records independently supplied by final-link audit. A source-build dependency alone is not treated as incorporated code.

recipeTransform.fallback: The unchanged upstream PdfFile/lib/xpdf/Decrypt.cc #else defines SHA384=sha384 and SHA512=sha512, selecting existing Xpdf implementation under its GPLv3 option.

validation.freshRecipeReplay: Separately required and recorded by drawing-build-provenance.json and release gate; native license review does not substitute for reproduction.

historicalReleaseFinding.finding: Publisher drawing recipe defined USE_OPENSSL_HASH; Decrypt.cc textually included OpenSSL1.1.1f SHA512/mem_clr C sources. No applicable OpenSSL/AGPL linking exception was found in pinned source licenses.
historicalReleaseFinding.resolution: Replaced drawing JS/WASM with verified local source build using existing Xpdf hash branch; no custom cryptography implementation was added.
